title: Same date, different records
dek: A six-minute paired investigation of Moneymore and Twin Falls: two catalogue records sharing a date and one publication issue, but requiring separate treatment.

research_items.title: Moneymore — 7 September 1956
research_items.subtitle: UFOCAT 89688 evidence dossier

research_items.title: Twin Falls — 7 September 1956
research_items.subtitle: UFOCAT 71217 evidence dossier
research_items.citation: Isaac Koi Archive. "Twin Falls — 7 September 1956." Evidence Dossiers, UFOCAT record 71217. https://isaackoi.com/search-archive/cases/twin-falls-1956/

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 1
checkpoints.title: Read the Moneymore record on its own terms
checkpoints.guidance: Capture its stable ID, place, date, and classifications before looking for similarities elsewhere. Shared dates are search clues, not evidence that records describe one event.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 2
checkpoints.title: Keep the Twin Falls record distinct
checkpoints.guidance: Repeat the same extraction for Twin Falls. Preserve its own record ID and location so later comparison cannot silently merge the two catalogue rows.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 3
checkpoints.title: View both locations before inferring a relationship
checkpoints.guidance: Open the records together and check their coordinate precision. A shared date does not erase geographic separation or uncertainty in either mapped point.

action.label: Open both records on the map

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 4
checkpoints.title: Trace Moneymore into the CSI issue
checkpoints.guidance: Open the reviewed CSI New York page route for Moneymore and retain its record-specific context while noting the publication identity.

facts.label: Issue
facts.value: Civlilian Saucer Intellligence of New York - No 17

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 5
checkpoints.title: Trace Twin Falls into the same CSI issue
checkpoints.guidance: The document ID matches the prior checkpoint because both routes reach the same publication issue. That shared container is provenance information—not permission to merge the catalogue records.

action.label: Open the Twin Falls CSI route

facts.label: Issue
facts.value: Civlilian Saucer Intellligence of New York - No 17

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 6
checkpoints.title: Compare without collapsing
checkpoints.guidance: Place both dossiers side by side. Keep distinct IDs, locations, source families, and citations visible even where date or publication context overlaps.

action.label: Add both dossiers to the research set
